$Remember Last SSS Page (m-ex) [Synapse]
*Reopens the m-ex stage select on the page last used (L/R still change pages).
*m-ex bases only (Akaneia, SSBM ACE).
*Synapse, Copyright (c) 2026 w3irDv, MIT licence: https://github.com/w3irDv/20XX-Synapse_Construct
*Don't enable it on a Synapse ISO that already bakes this feature (it would hook the same code twice).
